verdict.rationale: Bento supports event/tag-triggered automation flows and scripting API jobs (e.g. 'script the job you run every week'), which implies some recurring automation capability, but there is no explicit documentation of a scheduler, cron-like recurring job configuration, or AI-driven scheduling of workflows. Missing for 10: explicit recurring/scheduled job feature, AI-native interface for setting schedules, and independent confirmation of time-based (not just event-based) automation triggers.
